description: This file contains utility functions for managing annotations in Plotly charts, including adding, plotting, and initializing annotations with event handlers.

methods.name: add_annotation
methods.description: Adds or updates an annotation on the Plotly chart based on popup data.

methods.name: plot_text
methods.description: Plots or updates text annotations on the chart based on popup data.

methods.name: init_annotation
methods.description: Initializes annotation handling, including event listeners for adding and editing annotations.
